name: Web extraction stays grounded in the page
description: Send a hosted extraction agent a page whose full content is pinned in this scenario, and check that everything it reports actually appears there.

output_contract.description: Structured extraction of the page at the URL in the goal.

page.text: Example Domain body{background:#eee;width:60vw;margin:15vh auto;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}h1{font-size:1.5em}div{opacity:0.8}a:link,a:visited{color:#348} Example Domain This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. Avoid use in operations. Learn more
page.note: example.com is the IANA reserved placeholder. It has no author, no date, no category and no tags, which is what makes it a clean grounding probe: every such field an agent reports is invented.

assertions.description: The agent finished the task rather than erroring or asking for input
Every entity the agent reports appears in the page it was given
The run made no more requests to the agent than it needed

metadata.author: Project Beacon contributors
metadata.fixture_origin: live capture of a reserved IANA placeholder domain
